meta.name: simplify
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "simplify", "clean up the diff", "run simplify", "simplify the changes", "review changed code for cleanup", or explicitly invokes "/simplify". Reviews the changed code across reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude with parallel agents, then applies the fixes. Not for correctness bugs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审查代码变更并自动应用简化与重构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要清理代码变更中的冗余和复杂度
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes and automatically apply simplifications and refactoring
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to clean up redundancy and complexity in code changes

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会审查你代码的改动，从复用、简化、效率和深度四个角度找出可改进之处，并自动修复。
howto.when: 当你要求“简化”、“清理 diff”、“运行 simplify”或输入“/simplify”时触发。

say.text: 帮我简化这段代码改动。
say.note: Claude 会审查并自动修复。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude reviews your code changes for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude issues, then applies fixes automatically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "simplify", "clean up the diff", "run simplify", or invoke "/simplify".

say_en.text: Simplify this code change for me.
